A2: Pablo Picasso: A Famous Artist

Quality checked lesson

In this lesson, you will learn who Pablo Picasso was, why people still remember him, and what made his art special. You will also learn about the Blue Period, Cubism, and Guernica, which is a famous anti-war painting.

Introduction

Pablo Picasso was a very famous artist from Spain.

Spain is a country in Europe.

Picasso is one of the best-known names in modern art.

People remember him because he tried many different ways of making art.

He did not stay with only one style.

Have you seen a painting by Pablo Picasso before?

What kinds of art do you like: realistic, colorful, simple, or unusual?

Where do people usually see art: in a museum, at school, or online?

Practice

Where was Pablo Picasso born?

Picasso was born in 1881 in Spain.

What color did Picasso use a lot in the Blue Period?

The Blue Period is the name for one part of Picasso's life and art.

What happens to shapes and faces in Cubism?

Cubism was a new art style connected with Picasso.

Why is Guernica called an anti-war painting?

Guernica is one of Picasso's most famous paintings.

Summary

Pablo Picasso is remembered because he changed art in many ways.

He used color in the Blue Period to show sadness.

He used Cubism to show shapes and new ideas.

He made Guernica to speak about war and peace.

Picasso shows us that art can do many things.

It can show feelings.

It can ask questions.

It can send a message.

It can also help us see the world in a new way.
